"" : String(s[a:b]) starts(s, prefix, at = 1) = startswith(part(s, at), prefix) escapehtml(s) = replace(s, '&'=>"&", '<'=>"<", '>'=>">", '"'=>""") striptags(s) = replace(s, r"<[^>]*>"=>"") normalize(s) = join(split(lowercase(s)), " ") trim(s) = String(strip(s, ' ')) ltrim(s) = String(lstrip(s, ' ')) function skipspace(s, at) while at <= length(s) && s[at] in WHITE at += 1 end at end function escapedread(s, at, stops) out = IOBuffer() while at <= length(s) && !(s[at] in stops) if s[at] == '\\' && at < length(s) && s[at+1] in PUNCT at += 1 end print(out, s[at]) at += 1 end String(take!(out)), at end struct Reference url::String title::Union{Nothing,String} end mutable struct Block kind::Symbol text::String number::Int ordered::Bool lines::Vector{String} children::Vector{Block} items::Vector{Vector{Block}} alignments::Vector{String} rows::Vector{Vector{String}} end Block(kind, text = "", number = 0) = Block(kind, text, number, false, String[], Block[], Vector{Block}[], String[], Vector{String}[]) mutable struct Parser references::Dict{String,Reference} footnotes::Dict{String,String} end Parser() = Parser(Dict{String,Reference}(), Dict{String,String}()) function fence(line) m = match(r"^(`{3,}|~{3,})", line) m === nothing && return nothing run = String(m.match) info = trim(part(line, length(run)+1)) first(run) == '`' && occursin('`', info) && return nothing run, info end function atx(line) m = match(r"^(#{1,6})(?: |$)", line) m === nothing && return nothing n = length(m.captures[1]) text = trim(part(line, n+1)) shorter = String(rstrip(text, '#')) if isempty(shorter) || endswith(shorter, " ") text = trim(shorter) end Block(:heading, text, n) end rule(line) = occursin(r"^(?:-{3,}|\*{3,}|_{3,})$", replace(line, " "=>"")) function marker(line) rule(line) && return nothing m = match(r"^(?:([-*+])|([0-9]{1,9})([.)])) +", line) m === nothing && return nothing ordered = m.captures[2] !== nothing kind = String(ordered ? m.captures[3] : m.captures[1]) kind, ordered, ordered ? parse(Int, m.captures[2]) : 1, part(line, length(m.match)+1) end interrupts(line) = !startswith(line, " ") && ( fence(line)!==nothing || atx(line)!==nothing || rule(line) || startswith(line, ">") || marker(line)!==nothing ) function cells(line) text = trim(line) at = startswith(text, "|") ? 2 : 1 result = String[] out = IOBuffer() final_separator = false while at <= length(text) ch = text[at] at += 1 final_separator = false if ch == '\\' && at <= length(text) text[at] != '|' && print(out, '\\') print(out, text[at]) at += 1 elseif ch == '|' push!(result, trim(String(take!(out)))) final_separator = true else print(out, ch) end end !final_separator && push!(result, trim(String(take!(out)))) result end function definition!(p, line) m = match(r"^\[\^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\]:(.*)$", line) if m !== nothing && !isempty(trim(m.captures[2])) get!(p.footnotes, lowercase(m.captures[1]), trim(m.captures[2])) return true end startswith(line, "[") || return false close = findfirst(']', line) (close === nothing || !starts(line, ":", close+1)) && return false label = part(line, 2, close-1) (occursin('[', label) || isempty(trim(label)) || startswith(label, "^")) && return false url, finish = escapedread(line, skipspace(line, close+2), " ") isempty(url) && return false at = skipspace(line, finish) title = nothing if at <= length(line) (at == finish || !(line[at] in "\"'")) && return false title, finish = escapedread(line, at+1, string(line[at])) finish == length(line) || return false end get!(p.references, normalize(label), Reference(url, title)) true end function parseblocks!(p, lines) blocks = Block[] at = 1 while at <= length(lines) line = lines[at] if isempty(line) at += 1 continue elseif startswith(line, " ") finish = at while finish <= length(lines) && (isempty(lines[finish]) || startswith(lines[finish], " ")) finish += 1 end while isempty(lines[finish-1]) finish -= 1 end b = Block(:code) b.lines = [part(s, 5) for s in lines[at:(finish-1)]] push!(blocks, b) at = finish continue end if !startswith(line, " ") f = fence(line) if f !== nothing run, info = f b = Block(:code, isempty(info) ? "right" : "") for c in delimiters ] at += 2 while at<=length(lines) && occursin('|', lines[at]) row = cells(lines[at]) resize!(row, min(length(row), length(header))) while length(row)0 ? :heading : text=="[TOC]" ? :toc : :paragraph, text, level)) at = finish+(level>0) end blocks end struct Piece html::String char::Char count::Int opens::Bool closes::Bool end Piece(html::String) = Piece(html, ' ', 0, false, false) function emphasis(pieces, first = 1, last = length(pieces)) out = IOBuffer() at = first while at<=last p = pieces[at] close = 0 if p.opens for i in (at+1):last q = pieces[i] if q.closes && q.char==p.char && q.count==p.count close=i break end end end if close>0 open, shut = p.char=='~' ? ("", "") : p.count==1 ? ("", "") : p.count==2 ? ("", "") : ("", "") print(out, open, emphasis(pieces, at+1, close-1), shut) at=close+1 else print(out, p.count==0 ? p.html : repeat(string(p.char), p.count)) at+=1 end end String(take!(out)) end runend(s, at) = begin finish=at+1 while finish<=length(s) && s[finish]==s[at] finish+=1 end finish end function tickclose(s, at, count) while at<=length(s) if s[at]=='`' finish=runend(s, at) finish-at==count && return at at=finish else at+=1 end end 0 end function closingbracket(s, at) depth=0 while at<=length(s) if s[at]=='\\' at+=2 continue elseif s[at]=='`' finish=runend(s, at) close=tickclose(s, finish, finish-at) at=close==0 ? finish : close+finish-at continue elseif s[at]=='[' depth+=1 elseif s[at]==']' depth-=1 depth==0 && return at end at+=1 end 0 end mutable struct Renderer references::Dict{String,Reference} definitions::Dict{String,String} ids::Set{String} headings::Vector{Tuple{Int,String,String}} notes::Vector{String} counts::Vector{Int} end Renderer(p::Parser) = Renderer(p.references, p.footnotes, Set{String}(), Tuple{Int,String,String}[], String[], Int[]) function destination(r, s, at, label) if starts(s, "[", at) close=findnext(']', s, at+1) if close!==nothing && !occursin('[', part(s, at+1, close-1)) raw=part(s, at+1, close-1) name=normalize(isempty(raw) ? label : raw) return haskey(r.references, name) ? (r.references[name], close+1) : nothing end elseif starts(s, "(", at) url, finish=escapedread(s, skipspace(s, at+1), " \n)") next=skipspace(s, finish) title=nothing valid=true if next>finish && next<=length(s) && s[next] in "\"'" title, finish=escapedread(s, next+1, string(s[next])) valid=finish<=length(s) next=skipspace(s, finish+1) end valid && starts(s, ")", next) && return (Reference(url, title), next+1) end name=normalize(label) haskey(r.references, name) ? (r.references[name], at) : nothing end refid(n, count) = count==1 ? "fnref-$n" : "fnref-$n-$count" function noteref!(r, name) n=findfirst(==(name), r.notes) if n===nothing push!(r.notes, name) push!(r.counts, 0) n=length(r.notes) end r.counts[n]+=1 id=refid(n, r.counts[n]) "$n" end function inline!(r, s; links = true, notes = true) pieces=Piece[] at=1 while at<=length(s) ch=s[at] if ch=='\\' if at\n")) at+=2 else push!(pieces, Piece("\\")) at+=1 end continue elseif ch=='`' finish=runend(s, at) count=finish-at close=tickclose(s, finish, count) if close==0 push!(pieces, Piece(repeat("`", count))) at=finish else code=replace(part(s, finish, close-1), "\n"=>" ") if startswith(code, " ") && endswith(code, " ") && !isempty(trim(code)) code=part(code, 2, length(code)-1) end push!(pieces, Piece("$(escapehtml(code))")) at=close+count end continue end if links if ch=='<' close=findnext('>', s, at+1) if close!==nothing target=part(s, at+1, close-1) url=occursin(r"^https?://[^ \n<]+\z", target) email=occursin(r"^[A-Za-z0-9.+_-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+\z", target) if url || email href=escapehtml((email && !url ?     ") join(lines, "\n") end function toc(r) parents=Int[] stack=Int[] for (i, (level, id, label)) in enumerate(r.headings) while !isempty(stack) && r.headings[last(stack)][1]>=level pop!(stack) end push!(parents, isempty(stack) ? 0 : last(stack)) push!(stack, i) end function listing(parent) html="
